frames.undistorted_px: pixels of the photos as stored (already undistorted, newK = K); never undistort again
frames.floor_cm: PROVISIONAL E1 mat-seam floor plane: origin mat node (0,0) far-left, +x image right, +y towards the camera
frames.map_m: ROS2 map frame of map.yaml (REP-103 right-handed, z up): origin mat node (0,2), +y away from the camera
frames.odom/base_link: NOT defined here; map->odom comes from the robot's localisation

formulas.yaw: yaw_map = -yaw_floor (yaw_floor measured from +x_floor towards +y_floor, i.e. image right towards image down)

grid.row0: top image row = largest y_map (Nav2 map_server)

layer_codes.0: FREE (inside drivable zone Z02, no obstacle)
layer_codes.3: NOT_DRIVABLE (workspace outside Z02, or a mixed boundary cell)

floor_transform_record.method: local seam-line fits intersected at the mat-grid nodes -> DLT homography (cv2.findHomography, method 0, all nodes)
known_limits: mat edges near the image border are visibly curved: residual lens distortion remains after the read-only undistortion; the nodes on the bottom mat row (image y > 975) have the largest residuals and lie outside the planned work band
points above the floor (cube on the conveyor, tops of boxes) are displaced by parallax: only floor-level features map correctly
mat gaps are ignored as the user stated; a gap of a few mm would shift the node positions
